messages:
sam (AE): Heads-up — Aurelius Financial CISO has paused the POC. Blocking items: VPC peering details + BYO KMS proof. Customer wants an exec-level commit that we can get them data-isolated for the pilot. Need options and a clear ask by EOD.

marta (SE): On it. Two quick paths: (A) provision a short-lived Dedicated dev pool and support BYO KMS integration (requires infra + legal), or (B) run on hosted with strict audit + token redaction as a temporary compromise. Which do we want to propose to execs?

kevin (Sales Dir): We should offer (A) as primary and (B) as fallback. Sam — can you get the customer to accept a 2-week dedicated trial if we discount? I need a price to present to the CRO.

sam (AE): I can push for 2 weeks. Customer will want cost and a clear SLA for the trial. Marta — ballpark cost for a single small dedicated node (dev-grade)?

marta (SE): Ballpark: dedicated dev node ~ $12k/week (GPU-backed). Hosted+audit fallback ~ $3k/week with strict throttles. Quick calc snippet: 
```
base_ded = 12000
base_host = 3000
weeks = 2
ded_cost = base_ded * weeks
host_cost = base_host * weeks
```
So ded = $24k, hosted = $6k. We can flex pricing for exec signoff.

olivia (Security): KMS BYO requires an infra integration ticket and an HSM/KMS attestation from their side. Realistic timeline: 5 business days to fully validate and onboard keys end-to-end. If they need immediate assurance, we can offer customer-managed envelope keys (short-term) + enhanced logging, but legal still needs to sign off.

infra-bot: created ticket #INF-7842 -> "Aurelius KMS BYO + dedicated pool". ETA for initial provisioning estimate: 36 hours pending budget approval.

marta (SE): Proposed exec ask (one-liner we can send to CRO): "Approve a 2-week dedicated trial (discounted) and uplift a fast-track infra ticket for KMS BYO onboarding; engineering to provide runtime isolation + audit logs."

kevin (Sales Dir): Good. Sam, include that in your exec note. Also mention fallback (hosted with audit + token redaction) so they know we have continuity.

sam (AE): Done — added the one-pager and numbers to the customer thread: https://redwood.internal/docs/aurelius-poc-onepager. I asked for a CISO timeslot tomorrow morning to review options.

nate (Infra Lead): If we greenlight the dedicated trial, infra can carve a dev pool and start KMS integration in parallel. Need a headcount approval for the burst and a security contact from the customer.

olivia (Security): I'll start filling the security questionnaire now and will paste answers here by COB. For the temporary shared-key approach, I need to confirm retention windows and audit surface with legal.

kevin (Sales Dir): Action items: kevin -> escalate to CRO (now); sam -> secure CISO timeslot & send exec ask; marta -> coordinate pricing & infra ticket; nate -> confirm provisioning ETA; olivia -> Q questions answers. Target: unblock by EOD tomorrow. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

marta (SE): :thumbsup: looping in @nate. Nate, please flag any blocker that would push beyond 36h.

nate (Infra Lead): Noted. If legal needs HSM attestation from their KMS vendor, that could add 48-72h. Otherwise we can provision the dev pool in ~36h once finance approves the short-term commit.

sam (AE): Thanks all. I'll bring the customer's exec a clear "option A vs B" slide and the pricing numbers. Will post the meeting outcome here.

kevin (Sales Dir): Thanks team — keep this thread for updates only. If anyone needs direct help, DM me. :pray:
